interpretation: Exact CURRENT body center, velocity, angular velocity and physical plate offset propagated with constant rigid motion. This isolates acceleration/reversal mismatch, is not deployable and is not an information-theoretic lower bound. Future ground truth is used only to score and label reversals.
population: Same observable 3-5m exposure anchors where new model and SZU both have a valid frozen-tracker forecast. Refusals/coverage remain in the primary analysis; this paired diagnostic is not a new acceptance population.
